definition: the activity of doing something for someone's need
description: A student sits at a desk in front of a laptop and a stack of textbooks when he feels something on his upper lip and finds his nose is bleeding. He grabs a tissue and presses it to his nostrils, tipping his head. A friend comes over, pulls more tissues from the box on the desk and hands them to him, staying beside him while he holds them to his nose; the used tissues in the box are spotted with blood.

en.question: What is the sitting man doing?

de.answer: Er hält sich ein Taschentuch an die Nase.
de.question: Was macht der sitzende Mann?

es.answer: Se está sujetando un pañuelo contra la nariz.
phrases: estar sentado frente a un escritorio
